errors.text: The intervention is framed as generic property-prediction machine learning rather than a DFT-trained machine-learning interatomic potential coupled to free-energy perturbation.
It omits the replacement of slow thermodynamic integration with free-energy perturbation, which is the principal source of computational efficiency.
No alloy-specific composition, pressure, numerical temperature range, training accuracy, supercell size, or exchange-correlation treatment is specified.
The prediction has no quantitative accuracy or speedup targets and does not include electronic-excitation or short-range-order contributions.
No supporting prior evidence is cited, and the falsification rule lacks a predefined numerical tolerance.
